d: The OCC crew takes on an extraordinary challenge as they begin building a custom chopper inspired by America's Space Program and NASA's legendary astronauts. After visiting NASA facilities for inspiration, Paul Jr. and Rick Petko bring spacecraft-inspired details to the workshop, including rocket-style exhausts, futuristic wheels, and Space Shuttle-inspired bodywork. But translating aerospace designs into a custom motorcycle brings plenty of fabrication challenges. With Paul Sr. keeping a close eye on the schedule, the team races to get the build ready for paint. Watch American Chopper…
